selected_problem: Current Frank evidence has converged on live gate-issued effect capability plus immutable generation binding and provider commit serialization, but ClayCode compiler/type-effect/lowering has not proved that authority is noncopyable, nonserializable, generation-scoped and inseparable from the actual provider effect route.
fresh_internal_evidence: Current/historical V14 effect lifecycle admitted stale first-start, stale retry and unbound internal attempt paths into COMMITTING.
Target-compatible GO evidence reproduced copied generation-scalar piggyback: copied tuple data without the live lease/flock could start/retry in a raw-field candidate.

Fresh PR204 direction now includes immutable effect generation binding, live capability and provider commit critical-section/serialization; PR217 tests exact Gate-issued object identity against copy/manual construction.
Target VPS snapshot experiment restored epoch 1 after epoch 2 existed and resurrected the old epoch-1 capability; a test-only restore bump fenced it.
Hyperposition/HyperMath reentry now also treats execution/delivery generation as part of safe thin-handle validity and reports no evidence for super-Turing computation.
Previous ATOMIC PSW was refuted as a distinct architecture by a simpler sparse-overlay+memo baseline; ACEF remains an unpromoted transaction candidate.
fusion_1: The recurring defect class is not missing metadata but confusion between provenance identity and possession of live authority. The high-information ATOMIC question is whether ClayCode can make authority possession/lifetime a type-level fact rather than another runtime tuple comparison.

Generative Authority Region K brands one execution worldline; reservations/effects carry K.

Persist compact authority shadows/digests while refusing reification to authority.
Separate authority K from post-turnover OutcomeEvidence so reconciliation survives without retry authority.
Apply ST/GhostCell-style unnameable/branded permission identity to Frank execution authority.
Affine/nonserializable authority resources plus generative brand in TypedIR.
Exact gate-issued object registry only; no new type primitive; strongest minimal baseline.
External nonrollback incarnation composed with DB epoch for snapshot rollback.
Encode effect lifecycle as typestate/session protocol.
MAC/caveat capability bound to incarnation/execution/provider; rejected as likely unnecessary serializable bearer on one-host v0.1.
CHERI-like tagged authority; out of scope for current target hardware.

fusion_2: Broad novelty is destroyed. GAR does not invent fencing, capabilities, generative brands, affine resources or scoped effects. The surviving project-specific possibility is the composition of a fresh Frank execution-worldline brand K, a gate-issued nonserializable Capability<K>, a durable non-authoritative shadow, EffectReservation<K>, provider mutation executable only in EffectScope<K>, and post-turnover OutcomeEvidence that does not carry effect authority.

candidate.name: Generative Authority Region
candidate.one_sentence: Every effect-capable Frank execution lives inside a fresh unnameable authority region K; persistent bytes may remember its provenance but can never recreate possession, and provider mutation is legal only inside the matching live region.
candidate.important_nonclaim: Writing generic K in current G9 syntax does not prove these semantics; a TypedIR gap is explicitly recorded.
